alerts.name: content_5xx_rate_high
alerts.condition: rate of content_request with status>=500 > 1% over 5 minutes

alerts.name: content_publish_latency_high
alerts.condition: p95 latency of content_request for publish endpoints > 1 second over 15 minutes

alerts.name: content_health_dependency_down
alerts.condition: content health db or cache = error for 5 minutes
